This task requires additional information that is not provided, such as a source or method to determine the popularity of dishes and drinks. def is_popular(value):
    match = re.search(r'\d+\.\d+', value)
    return bool(match)

menu = [
    "Eischaum-Nocken",
    "[Hot + Buns]",
    "chicken Fricassee with Boiled Rice",
    "Konigsberger Klops in Kapernsauce, Rote Bete, Kartoffeln",
    "Hot Wagon Service",
    "Banana Cream Pie",
    "[DINNER READY]",
    "Omelette 'Königin-Art'",
    "Chicken Saute Chasseur, White Wine Sauce, Parslty Potato and Green Peas",
    "coffee Ice Cream, caramel sauce",
    "Saumon grille, beurre Maitre d'hotel",
    "Omelette with Sausage",
    "Filet of beef with mushrooms",
    "Toast au Lait",
    "HIS EYE BEGETS OCCASION FOR HIS WIT.",
    "Souther Colada - Southern comfort, Ananassaft, Kokosnußcreme",
    "Mexican Tamales",
    "?  London Broil on Toast, Tomato Sauce;",
    "creme du nord",
    "Sparkling burgundy"
]

popular_dishes = [dish for dish in menu if is_popular(dish)]
unpopular_dishes = [dish for dish in menu if not is_popular(dish)]
print("Popular dishes:", popular_dishes)
print("Unpopular dishes:", unpopular_dishes)
